name: @vssaros/dsh-media
description: VsSaros media library for DeepSeek Harness. **As of 2026-10-24 the authoritative store is on the dsh side**: `{dataRoot}/media-store/media.db` + content-addressed objects under `{dataRoot}/media-store/objects/<sha8[0..2]>/<sha8>.<ext>`, created and owned by this module (single writer), with a full read/write HTTP API under `/x/media/api/*` (list / facets / stats / bytes / thumb / import / delete / restore / favorite / tags / board / note). The page (`/x/media/`, rewritten 2026-10-26 after Eagle) is a three-column asset manager: left navigation (kind / favorites / unclassified / untagged / trash / boards / tags), a filter bar with three view modes, a detail inspector with inline editing, and batch writes throttled to 20 items x 3 lanes. 256px webp thumbnails are cached content-addressed at `{dataRoot}/media-store/thumbs/<sha8>.webp` (the Host has no image encoder, so the page encodes on first paint and posts the bytes back). The old VsSaros main-process store (`{rootDir}/media.db`) is still readable as a **read-only mirror** for reconciliation (`?source=ide`).
